hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that acts as the shared rule engine for every launchpad pool. On each swap it applies a dynamic LP fee, takes configurable protocol and creator fee cuts, optionally burns tokens, donates a portion of fees back to the pool, and distributes the remainder to module escrows and claimable balances. Up to 8 owner-approved modules can extend behavior at launch, liquidity, and trade time.
